name: truck-make-inline-completion
title: Typing a truck make key by key keeps exactly what was typed

issue.title: Typing a truck make key by key saves a corrupted value (KENWORTH becomes KENWORTHWORTH)
issue.expected: After typing KENWORTH and pressing Tab, Truck make is KENWORTH and no 'not in the register' note appears.
issue.actual: The field holds KENWORTHWORTH ('Ken' gives 'KenT KENWORTH'), and DT records that value.
issue.dt_test: tests/desktop/test_vehicle_ui.py: combo = window.vehicle_choices['truck_make']; focus it, QTest.keyClicks(combo.lineEdit(), 'KENWORTH'), press Tab, then assert combo.currentText() == 'KENWORTH' and that the saved preparation holds 'KENWORTH'.
suspected: dt/ui.py: MainWindow.searchable_combo sets Qt.MatchContains on the editable combo's default InlineCompletion completer

expect.lacks: is not in the Australian approvals register
